items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you went to Joe Allard for that... you were having some problems playing sharp and you went to Joe Allard

ctx.x: So I learned to play the high sharp and I think that’s part of the reason for my distinct sound.
Many years ago, by the way, you told me a great story about intonation and playing sharp, that you went to Joe Allard for that, do you remember that story that you told me?
